title: Fabnilla Plus
description: A fabric based modpack based around vanilla additions.
body:
![Fabnilla Plus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d562030af634bba29bffeaf64dbebcf5fc02081.png)
### Fabnilla Plus is a fabric modpack focused on adding extras to vanilla features.

![Description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6849c91d0257b0eec451284e8c5ce6a6980b2a5f.png)
Ever wanted a modpack that is light with performance improvements and doesn't change the game but just adds more to the stuff already in vanilla minecraft. Well here it is Fabnilla Plus a fabric modpack that adds extra to vanilla minecraft.

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a019da9aab0e65a843e79479397ee1960be7ba6.png)
Fabnilla Plus has many features including:
- Combat mechanics from minecraft dungeons, swords swipe and you can even roll.
- Better structures thanks to YUNG's better mods.
- Cats have more breeds and better looking models and some secret ones.
- Wolves look better but when tamed turn into a dog which there are many breeds and some secret ones.
- The Nether has more biomes, blocks and structures thanks to betternether.
- The End has more biomes, blocks and structures thanks to betterend.
- Villages have new buildings and look better.
- Better third person camera allowing you to move the whole camera around without the player moving.
- Better F3 so it is more readable.
- Better Advancements and statistics.
- Armour trims have unique effects.
- Better Archaeology adding structures and more fossils.

![Mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5721d69b3538b12bde337f58ba9ed81f96d7fd4b.png)
